prompt:
Pixel-art ground texture for a top-down JRPG map: fresh deep snow with soft wind-sculpted bumps, a few footprints, blue-white The square is about 256 x 256 art pixels (each art pixel about 7x7 image pixels).
Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art ("HD pixel art" JRPG look), hand-placed pixels. Every art pixel is a crisp square of the same size across the whole image (about 8x8 image pixels per art pixel). No anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft brushes, no photographic texture, no noise, no dithering checkerboards. Clusters of 3-10 pixels with clear shapes. Hue-shifted colour ramps: shadows lean toward purple/red and are more saturated, highlights lean toward warm yellow. 4-6 shades per material, rich but earthy, worn and lived-in.
Camera: classic top-down RPG map view (seen from above at a steep angle, like a 16-bit era overworld/town map), orthographic, no perspective convergence.
Lighting: neutral, soft, even light from the upper left, like a calm overcast evening; NO cast shadows, NO night darkness, NO light sources, NO glow, NO lamp light pools, NO vignette. (The game engine adds the night lighting on top later, so this must be the clean base colours.)
It must be a SEAMLESS TILEABLE texture: the left edge continues into the right edge and the top edge into the bottom edge. Fill the entire square edge to edge with the surface only: no border, no frame, no objects, no characters, no text, no single focal feature, even distribution of detail.
revised_prompt: Generate a SQUARE seamless tileable ground texture for a top-down JRPG map, entirely fresh deep snow, pale blue-white with softly wind-sculpted shallow bumps and a few small understated footprints distributed across the tile. Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art JRPG look, meticulously hand-placed crisp uniform square pixels, each rendered pixel visibly large and identical sized, approximately 7–8 screen pixels wide. Hard pixel boundaries throughout: absolutely no antialiasing, blur, gradients, soft brushes, photo textures, noise, or checkerboard dithering. Shape the terrain with legible 3–10-pixel clusters and 4–6 carefully chosen shades of snow, blue-white base, gently warm creamy yellow highlights and subtle more saturated purple-red/cool lavender shadow accents. Classic orthographic steep top-down overworld map camera, no perspective. Clean, neutral, soft evenly distributed upper-left illumination, no cast shadows, night darkness, glow, localized light, or vignette. Essential: perfectly seamless repeat at BOTH axes: left and right edges continue each other, top and bottom edges continue each other, pixel-perfect matching edge details. Even density of subtle detail over entire square, no central focal point, no border, no frame, no objects, no characters, no text. Square output.
